title: Calamum KEYSMITH: Sandboxed Moltbook key minting (claim-url only humans; sealed-drop secrets)

context.summary: KEYSMITH is a sandboxed utility/container that registers a Moltbook agent and obtains an api_key without exposing secrets to humans. Humans may complete a vendor claim ceremony using claim_url only (non-secret). The secret must be transferred via sealed drop and imported into VAULT/OS secret storage.
assumptions: Vendor provides an agent registration endpoint that returns a claim_url and an api_key.
The claim step requires human action or external verification, but does not require the human to ever see the api_key.
Network access for registration can be constrained to the sandbox; operators do not run vendor-provided curl on the host.
Observer runtime consumes credentials strictly via environment variable presence (MOLTBOOK_API_KEY).
risks: Secret exposure via stdout/stderr, debug logs, or exception traces.
Accidental persistence of api_key to tracked files or commit history.
Redirect or non-canonical host during registration leading to credential theft.
Over-automation of the claim ceremony beyond authorized human involvement.
stop_conditions: api_key appears in any log/stdout/stderr output.
api_key is written to a tracked path or an unsealed plaintext file.
Any workflow requires a human to copy/paste or view the api_key.
Unexpected host/redirect/non-canonical endpoint is observed during registration.

milestones.name: Contract + safety envelope
definition_of_done: Allowlist + stop-conditions captured and tested (no-secret logging).
Human ceremony documented as claim_url-only; secret handling is sealed-drop only.

milestones.name: Sandboxed registration client
definition_of_done: Registration call executes inside sandbox only.
Only allowlisted artifacts are persisted (claim_url in plaintext; api_key sealed).
Connectivity validation uses HTTPS-level probes; no ICMP assumptions.

milestones.name: Sealed drop + VAULT import
definition_of_done: Operator can import into VAULT/OS secret store with presence-only validation (no secret display).
Import step integrates with existing vault/env tooling surfaces.

milestones.name: Tests + evidence
definition_of_done: Automated tests cover fail-closed behavior, redaction, and secret non-exposure.
Evidence pointers recorded (names-only) for gate events + job report.

success_metrics: Humans never view/copy/paste the api_key; claim_url-only ceremony is sufficient.
No secret values appear in logs, stdout, stderr, or tracked files.
Operator can populate MOLTBOOK_API_KEY into runtime environment using sealed drop + VAULT/OS secret storage.
Observer continues to fail-closed if LIVE is requested without MOLTBOOK_API_KEY present.
